property_summary: For any caller and for any block timestamp, a successful payable fallback call of exactly 10 ether always makes c.pastBlockTime increase to the current block.timestamp (so an immediate second identical call in the same timestamp will revert); the mutant that omits the assignment can accept two such calls at the same timestamp, violating this rule.
change_summary: Remove the state update pastBlockTime = block.timestamp; so the timestamp is never recorded (single-statement deletion of the assignment).
